page.layout: One page, no printed text of its own. Faint mirrored text from the other side shows through the paper in the upper half and lower centre. A library seal (Bibliotheca Genevensis) is stamped in the centre, and a handwritten shelf mark sits above it.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through, the library seal and a manuscript shelf mark (10/4139). None of these is printed text, so none is transcribed. The faint mirrored lines at the top and centre are show-through from the title page on the reverse, and cannot be read reliably as printed text on this side.
